description: Lists the Insights articles (B2B e-commerce, ERP integration, agentic commerce, .NET modernization, .NET MAUI) with publish dates and summaries, newest first. Use get_page to read one. English by default; set language for the Spanish, Portuguese or Chinese site.

language.description: Optional language: en (default), es, pt or zh. Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese results come from projectthunder.mx, pt.projectthunder.com and projectthunder.asia. The ERP partner directory and partner profiles exist only in English: search and list them without a language (get_page returns them in English).

name: list_articles
title: List ProjectThunder Insights articles
